newsitem.title: UK: Sterling rises above old ERM floor at 2.7780 marks.
newsitem.headline: Sterling rises above old ERM floor at 2.7780 marks.

text.p: The British pound rose to its highest level against the German mark since September 1992, rallying above its old floor in the European exchange rate mechanism, dealers said.
Sterling rose to 2.7808 marks and up almost three pfennigs from 2.7533/43 marks late Friday.
The UK left the ERM in September 1992. Its old central rate within the mechanism was 2.95 marks.
The pound was easier on the day against a robust dollar, trading at $1.6274/84 compared with $1.6370/80 late last week.
